title: The Male CEO and the Female Assistant: Evaluation and Mitigation of Gender Biases in Text-To-Image Generation of Dual Subjects

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Paired Stereotype Test (PST) framework to prompt Text-to-Image models to generate dual-subject images with contrasting occupational or organizational power roles, and calculating a Stereotype Score (SS) based on human and automated classification of the generated individuals' masculine or feminine traits.
